newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia completes Avalon airport sale.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia completes Avalon airport sale.

text.p: Australian Finance Minister John Fahey said on Monday the government had sold Avalon airport near Geelong, Victoria, to Foxerco Pty Ltd for a series of payments with a net present value of A$11 million.
"Foxerco will acquire a 50-year lease with a 49-year option," Fahey said.
The aviation use of the airport would continue, he said.
Foxerco is a joint venture between large private transport group Linfox Transport (Australia) Pty Ltd and aviation concern Serco Aviation Services Pty Ltd.
The government is privatising an airport portfolio valued at more than A$2 billion by the sale of long leases.
